label: Amore: love shed abroad over Italy and Europe
description: The word life, then amore heard repeatedly, which his son translates as love, with love being shed abroad over the land of Italy and Europe.
aliases: Love was being shed abroad all over the land of Italy

label: Taiwan falls during the tribulation, on a ten year window
description: A decade long window seen over Taiwan and China running into the tribulation, with Taiwan falling during the tribulation rather than now. He says explicitly that he could miss it and that he is human. Distinct from taiwan-two-day-fall, which is the manner of the fall rather than the timing.
aliases: Taiwan will fall during the tribulation
Could I miss it? Yeah, I'm human

label: Zelensky as a black widow weaving a web across Europe
description: The Ukrainian president seen turning into a black widow spider with a shiny red marking, weaving a web across Europe as he tours European capitals. Distinct from black-widow-wrapping-first-amendment, which is a different spider over American speech.
aliases: he turns into a black widow spider
he weaves a web across Europe with a spider

label: Nothing happened on the 14th and all 23 planners are in custody
description: Thanks given that nothing happened on the fourteenth and that all twenty three of the people who had planned evil works are now in custody and will not hurt civilians, presented as answered prayer over a date he says was highlighted to him in advance.
aliases: to protect the 14th, that nothing happened
all 23 of them are now in custody
the people that had planned to do evil works

label: Taiwan is given a reprieve and the communist curtain is held back
description: That it is not time yet for Taiwan, that God will hold it back and hold back the communist curtain if the church prays, with a dome of protection over it and Asian nations and Australia coming to its aid. He says they have their plans but God has his.
aliases: It will not happen yet concerning Taiwan
I will hold it back. I see a dome of protection

label: Four white doves circling the American flag in a storm
description: The American flag standing in the middle of the land with a storm all around it, and four white doves circling the flag. Given without an interpretation.
aliases: I see the four doves circling our flag
I see four doves, white doves

label: Darkness on the land toward the east of America
description: A great shaking with darkness seen over the land toward the east of America while the light comes on the church, given as the time frame for the Taiwan and Asia material.
aliases: I see darkness upon the land toward the east of America
I see the light coming on the church
